notes: Second pass re-retrieved with 14 differently worded domain-restricted searches. Cut: Mohs surgery sentences (no UK official support retrieved), NCI sunscreen sentence, 'no symptoms' CRUK claim, actinic keratosis 'more at risk' claim, 'small when early' claim, the inferential 'therefore' FAQ sentence, and textbook filler (textbook now 3 of 114 ledger sentences, definition counted twice). Reworded: four-week and two-week NHS wording, 'main sign' to 'early sign', BCC is most common non-melanoma type, 'creams' to NHS list (radiotherapy, medicines, PDT, chemotherapy), surgery main treatment narrowed to non-melanoma and early melanoma. ct-scan link now supported (NHS lists CT or MRI scans after confirmed melanoma); mri link added; check_batch ends ok. No 999 route is stated because no retrieved text gives one for skin cancer; routes named are a non-urgent GP appointment and the NHS two-week specialist referral. Staging/outlook not covered. Weak points: UK frequency sentence rests on a retrieved summary of the NHS what-is page; older-age and outdoor-work risk statements come from summaries of CRUK/NHS risk pages whose wording was blended; BAD leaflet statements come from a summary of the 2020 leaflet.
